facts.text: DNX64.__init__ loads the vendor library with ctypes.CDLL(dll_path) and setup_methods assigns every signature in METHOD_SIGNATURES
Init() initializes the control object and reports False with a connection message when the DLL raises OSError
The FieldDino app hard-codes the vendor library path C:\Program Files\DNX64\DNX64.dll
start_microscope creates DNX64(self.driver_path), sets the video device index, calls Init and reads GetVideoDeviceName
GetVideoDeviceName returns the name of the video device for an index
GetDeviceID returns the unique device ID for an index
GetExposureValue returns the exposure value for the device index
SetExposureValue forwards the exposure value to the vendor DLL
The app's exposure spin box is set to the UI range 1 to 1000
GetAETarget returns the AE target value for the device index
SetAETarget documents the acceptable AE target range 16 to 20
GetAutoExposure returns the auto exposure value, and its docstring says 0 = OFF and 1 = ON
SetAutoExposure accepts 0 and 1
SetLEDState sets the LED state; it is controllable only while the camera preview is established and is not applicable to AM211, AM2011 and the Dino-Eye series
At start-up the app switches the LED on with SetLEDState(device_index, 1)
toggle_led flips the app's boolean LED state and writes it to SetLEDState as an int
SetFLCLevel documents that the FLC level accepts 1 to 6
The README targets the Dino-Lite AM7515 series of USB microscopes
The README says the app is Windows only for now
The README asks for the Dino-Lite SDK licence agreement and says the SDK installs DNX64.dll at C:\Program Files\DNX64\DNX64.dll
The README says the app was tested with USB cable connections only, not the WiFi Dino-Lite models
The app reads live frames with cv2.VideoCapture(self.camera_index, cv2.CAP_DSHOW) at 2592 x 1944, separately from DNX64
The DNX64 method table lists control and metadata functions but no frame or image acquisition function
The README says axial illumination control was removed from the app because it gave very harsh reflections
